name: animate-grid

frames.best_why: Frame 5 shows one tile lifted high and brightly glowing while all sixteen tiles stay in view.

tagline: Tilted icon tiles lift and glow as the cursor crosses them.
summary: A four-by-four grid of dark emoji tiles shown at a 3D angle. Hovering a tile pops it forward on a white fill with a green glow, and its four neighbours rise a little too.
appearance: A tall narrow block holding sixteen small square tiles in a four-column grid, tilted in perspective so the left edge recedes. Each tile carries a coloured emoji, a thin pale border and a soft pale shadow on a black stage.
behaviour: On pointer enter, the hovered tile scales up, shifts toward the viewer, turns white and pulses a green drop-shadow glow; the tiles directly above, below and beside it lift slightly. Leaving eases everything back after a short delay.
demo_content: Sixteen emoji icons including atom, diamond, butterfly, flame, rocket, star, rainbow and masks.
search_phrases: grid of icons that lift on hover
neighbouring cards pop up when hovered
interactive tile grid for tech stack
tilted grid with glow on hover
hover effect on a grid of logos
use_when: A small set of icons or logos should feel tactile and react together as the cursor moves.
avoid_when: Hover is the only trigger, so on touch devices nothing lifts and the grid stays inert.
customise: Feed items through the cards array and draw each with renderCard; perspective, the two rotations and the glow colours are props, while the lift and white fill are in the source.
weight_why: Sixteen divs with CSS transitions and two keyframe glows; idle until a pointer enters.

a11y.note: Tiles are plain divs with mouse listeners only: no tab stop, no keyboard path, and the emoji have no labels.

issues: The hovered tile turns solid white, leaving the emoji barely visible against it.
Neighbour lookup uses index plus or minus four, so any grid that is not four columns lifts the wrong tiles.
polish_why: Distinctive lift-and-glow hover, but idle tiles are dim and the white hover fill hides the icon.
title: 3D Hover Grid
